solution: After scientists deciphered a strange signal detected by a probe and concluded it originated from extraterrestrial life, a four-person team traveled by spaceship to the suspected location. An alien creature, already lying in wait, infiltrated the vessel while the team was out conducting a routine search; it killed and devoured the crew member left behind (Shirley), then mimicked her appearance, intending to blend in with the group and return to Earth to secure the planet's precise coordinates. To avoid detection, the creature released a toxin upon the team's return, rendering them unconscious and erasing parts of their memories. When the amnesiac crew members awoke, the alien—still struggling to adapt to its simulated human body and voice—stuttered as it mingled with them, waiting to guide the group back home.
